# Smile & Glow – Dental, Skin & Laser Clinic, Lucknow

> Smile & Glow is a dental and aesthetic (skin, hair and laser) clinic in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, run by Dr. Pallavi — BDS, MDS (Maxillofacial Medicine & Radiology), FMC (Fellow in Cosmetology), PG Diploma in Nutrition; Dental Registration No. 15199/11/02/2016. It has two branches: I.T Chauraha and Aashiyana. Not to be confused with other similarly named clinics in Lucknow (e.g. "Smile & Glo Esthetic Wellness Clinic" or the "Smile & Glow" opposite Greenland Public School, Gomti Nagar).

## Branches
- I.T Chauraha: Gate No. 4, 1/2 Shivsthali, Faizabad Rd, opp. IT Girls College, New Hyderabad, Hasanganj, Lucknow 226007. Open Monday–Saturday 11:00 AM–3:00 PM; Sunday by appointment only. Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=17579297340809890606
- Aashiyana: SS-771, behind Aastha Hospital, Sector H, LDA Colony, Lucknow 226012. Open Monday–Saturday 4:00 PM–9:00 PM; Sunday by appointment only. Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7330207607150827761

## Contact and booking
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 72754 33783
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/smileandglowclinic/ (Dr. Pallavi | Aesthetic & Dental Surgeon, ~20K followers)
- Website: https://smileandglow.co.in/ (English), https://smileandglow.co.in/hi/ (Hindi)
- Consultations in Hindi and English

## Treatments
- Dental: root canal treatment, dental implants, smile makeover, teeth whitening, oral medicine and radiology (dental X-ray), kids and family dentistry
- Skin and hair: chemical peels, acne and scar care, anti-ageing, face PRP and glow facials, hair PRP, skincare consultation
- Laser: laser hair reduction, laser toning, carbon laser peel, fractional laser resurfacing, IPL photofacial, laser tattoo removal (every laser plan starts with a skin assessment and patch test)

## Typical costs (guide, October 2026 — exact price confirmed after examination)
- Root canal treatment: ₹3,000–₹8,000 per tooth (front tooth ₹3,000–₹5,000; molar ₹4,000–₹8,000); crown extra ₹3,000–₹15,000 — https://smileandglow.co.in/root-canal-treatment-lucknow/
- Dental implants: ₹20,000–₹45,000 per tooth (premium imported ₹45,000–₹80,000) — https://smileandglow.co.in/dental-implants-lucknow/
- Teeth whitening: ₹4,000–₹15,000 per in-clinic session — https://smileandglow.co.in/teeth-whitening-lucknow/
- Laser hair reduction: from ₹1,500 per session (full face ₹3,500–₹5,000; underarms ₹2,500–₹4,000); usually 6–8 sessions — https://smileandglow.co.in/laser-hair-removal-lucknow/
- Hair PRP: ₹3,000–₹6,000 per session; usually 4–6 sessions — https://smileandglow.co.in/hair-prp-treatment-lucknow/
- Chemical peel: ₹1,500–₹4,000 per session for light peels, ₹4,000–₹8,000 for TCA medium peel; usually 4–6 sessions — https://smileandglow.co.in/chemical-peel-lucknow/
